what_happened: Confirmed via live BimodalLogic evidence (heartbeat-trace.log, git log) that heartbeat silence for tasks 696/649 is a design gap: 11 of 13 domain *-implementation-agent.md files never call update-phase-status.sh, bypassing the mechanized heartbeat entirely via direct Edit-tool phase-heading mutation. Only general-implementation-agent.md was migrated.

Piece 1's full remediation (migrating ~11 domain *-implementation-agent.md files to call update-phase-status.sh) likely exceeds this task's file_scope (agent-system/extensions/core/ only) since those agent files live in other extensions (lean, typst, latex, etc). Plan must make an explicit scope decision rather than silently widening or dropping the fix.

The dead-session-registry-entries item (ALSO OBSERVED note) is already correctly handled: skill-refresh/SKILL.md already calls task-lock.sh session-reap on explicit /refresh invocation. No code change needed; dropped from plan scope, saving implementation effort.

Piece 1's file_scope tension (13 un-migrated agent files across 12 other extensions) was resolved without widening scope: orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh and orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh are per-dispatch, agent-prose-independent heartbeat sites inside core, and lint-agent-contracts.sh's Check G already carries the curated 14-agent in-scope set the regression lint can reuse.

test-four-tier-conflict.sh Case 6 (budget-bound, 1000ms budget) fails under current machine load (~3000ms elapsed) both against the pristine HEAD task-lock.sh and the Phase 4 held-live modified version -- confirmed pre-existing, load-dependent, unrelated to this task's cmd_check changes. Likely caused by concurrent sibling /orchestrate dispatches (tasks 366, 271, 306) on this same machine per this dispatch's territory block.

Phases 4 and 6's new test fixtures used literal 'task NNN' phrasing for fictional fixture project numbers (810, 811, 813), tripping check-task-references.sh outside specs/**. Fixed by rewording to 'project NNN' / 'fixture project NNN' in scripts/test-session-registry.sh and scripts/tests/test-task-lock-liveness.sh; re-ran check-task-references.sh (0 occurrences) and both affected suites (13/13, 15/15) after the fix.

Phase 8 gate sweep found check-extension-docs.sh (invoked transitively by test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh's full-battery baseline case) flagging 3 real defects from this task: scripts/lib/phase-heartbeat-lib.sh, scripts/tests/test-task-lock-liveness.sh, and scripts/tests/test-lint-agent-contracts-heartbeat.sh were new source files never registered in manifest.json's provides.scripts array, and index-entries.json's patterns/task-lock.md line_count (1248) had drifted from the file's actual new line count (1416) after this task's edits. Fixed: added all 3 to manifest.json provides.scripts (alphabetically placed) and corrected task-lock.md's line_count to 1416. Re-ran check-extension-docs.sh: FAIL count dropped from 9 to 5, the remaining 5 being line_count mismatches on files outside this task's file_scope (plan-format.md, state-management-schema.md, state-schema.json, shell-script-testing.md, todo-archival-reference.md), owned by concurrently in-flight sibling tasks (271/366) and deliberately left untouched to avoid stepping on their work.

An earlier uncommitted fix to index-entries.json's patterns/task-lock.md line_count (1248->1416) was silently clobbered by a concurrent sibling task's own commit to the same file (task 306 phase 7, commit 2d397ae1f, which has index-entries.json in its own declared file_scope) before this task committed it -- git diff showed zero delta and the stale 1248 value was back on disk. Redone and committed immediately (commit 12d523438) to minimize the race window. Confirms the general hazard: an uncommitted edit to a file in ANOTHER concurrently-dispatched task's file_scope can be lost to a lost-update race if not committed promptly; manifest.json's own concurrent 3-line addition survived only because no sibling's file_scope declared that exact file during this window.

Full verify-deploy.sh sweep (Phase 8) found Gate 12 (lint-state-writer-boundary.sh) flagging 4 new lines in this task's own test fixtures (test-session-registry.sh Case 11/12's widen-then-heartbeat jq+mv, test-task-lock-liveness.sh Cases 6/7's two-live-sessions-overlap jq+mv) as hand-rolled state.json writes. Both mutate a throwaway $TMPROOT/specs/state.json, never the real specs/state.json. Added both files to lint-state-writer-boundary.sh's EXCLUDED_FILES allowlist with justification, mirroring the existing test-update-task-status.sh precedent. Re-verified: 0 violations; test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh still 8/8.

run-all.sh's full sweep surfaces test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh failing 6/15 cases (SKILL_VALIDATE_FIXES/SKILL_VALIDATE_FIXED_FILES global-state reset logic in skill-base.sh's direct-function-call Cases 3/4/6/6b). Confirmed unrelated to task 272: reproduces identically in a completely clean env (env -i), reproduces against a worktree checkout of the pre-task-272 commit (77bdb2e33) using the live .claude/scripts/ tree, and none of its four dependency files (skill-base.sh, validate-artifact.sh, command-gate-out.sh, the test itself) were touched by task 272 or any currently-scheduled sibling (git log shows task 352/337/285/327 as the most recent touches, all predating this cycle). Recorded for visibility only -- out of this task's file_scope and not remediated here; test-four-tier-conflict.sh's earlier flaky Case 6 timing failure has since cleared on a re-run (13/13), confirming that one was pure machine-load noise.
